usage: deskops inbox [-h] [--kind {unclear,suggestion}] [--title TITLE]
                     [--root ROOT] [--desk-root DESK_ROOT] [--store STORE]
                     [--repo REPO] [--sender SENDER] [--pythonpath PYTHONPATH]
                     [--list] [--show SHOW] [--ack ACK] [--limit LIMIT]
                     [--format {text,json,yaml}]
                     [message]

positional arguments:
  message               Inbox note body

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --kind {unclear,suggestion}
                        Type of inbox message to write
  --title TITLE         Short title for the note
  --root ROOT           Repository root whose desk/ holds the inbox; the same --root every other subcommand takes
  --desk-root DESK_ROOT
                        Desk root directory override; defaults to the active project desk
  --store STORE         Store path used to resolve the target project root for the default desk
  --repo REPO           Target a registered repository name in the ecosystem
  --sender SENDER       Override the resolved sender identity with a registered project id
  --pythonpath PYTHONPATH
                        Project path used when auto-tracking inbox notes through a registered InboxNoteDoc model
  --list                List desk inbox notes
  --show SHOW           Show one inbox note by filename, stem, or slug fragment
  --ack ACK             Acknowledge one inbox note by filename, stem, or slug fragment
  --limit LIMIT         Limit listed notes
  --format {text,json,yaml}

Deprecated: use `deskops message send|list|read|ack`.

Examples:
  deskops inbox "Need clearer CLI help" --kind unclear --title "CLI help"
  deskops inbox --repo sibling-repo --sender current-repo "Need follow-up"
  deskops inbox --list --root .
  deskops inbox --show 20260614-cli-help --root .
  deskops inbox --ack 20260614-cli-help --root .

--show/--ack selector: filename, stem, or slug fragment.
